svg.title: nonlinear291 — the folded gadget mask-first decomposed to fan-in ≤ 2
svg.desc: The replicated per-gate body: exactly 291 gates, deterministically (the '291' in the name). Same gadget as nonlinear193 (gate_gadget_v2.gadget_gate) but every fan-in ≥ 3 gate is decomposed mask-first into fan-in ≤ 2 Toffolis (gate_gadget_w2.Weight2Circuit): mask controls fold into the accumulator FIRST so no bare operand monomial ever appears on an ancilla. mp* wires are the persistent mask-prefix cache (shared subexpressions like R0·scr), uncomputed by flush(); dec0/dec1 fallback ancillas; tmp unused here. Encoding setup / 0-gate relabel not shown.
svg.text: nonlinear291 — the folded gadget mask-first decomposed to fan-in ≤ 2

c' = c ⊕ (a ∨ ¬b); share1' = R, share2' = (s2_0, s2_1, o0, o1, o2) — the relabel costs 0 gates
